scope: Independent read-only production client source review relative to exact sealed HF02 predecessors, plus executed Python-only final-cache structural/hash checks. No Rust test/build, native code, animation sampling, GUI or GPU execution performed by this reviewer. Not final package or full playback acceptance.

reviewed_behavior.conclusion: Selection identity uses full rig paths, independently tracks loading and loaded paths, queues the latest clicked animation while a request is pending, and disables clip controls until the loaded path matches the selected path. Short-name ambiguity in CLI resolve is an explicit error; full original source paths disambiguate.

Worker panics/disconnections and validation/upload failures become visible errors. Starting a load pauses old playback; prior loaded content is explicitly labeled while another selection loads. After a successful renderer epoch replacement, old animation/live/picking owners are cleared before the new sampled pose is adopted. No result can arrive for a second concurrent request because only one receiver is active.

Manifest paths reject traversal/absolute/colon/backslash/NUL forms and canonicalize within the manifest directory. Loads require a published path and exact rig digest. Original NIF SHA, paired converted model SHA, audited retained mesh order/name/topology and count checks remain on the inspector path. Final manifest-to-file source/clip identity was independently checked for every rig, rather than assumed from labels.

A single sampled pose supplies geometry, alpha overrides and visibility. Each frame restores base opacity when an override is absent, then uses a single vertex alpha multiplier because material uniform color remains1. RepColor texture alpha remains a mask; only sourced alpha-controller meshes may use the authored blend bit. Complete input validation precedes update_vertices; draw visibility changes afterward and both opaque/translucent commands honor it. Successful updates invalidate draw-order/bundle caches.

Inspector load_preview/sample_preview is separate from the strict live/runtime asset loader. All unavailable animated sources retain reasons in the UI/CLI; supported geometry timelines retain unsupported effect/controller metadata and warning text. This does not reconstruct particles, events, audio, gameplay selection or battle behavior.

limitations: No animation sampler, Rust unit binary, native oracle, GUI selection, actual GPU upload/readback or capture was executed by this reviewer. Existing peer test reports were read only and are not reasserted as this review's test results.
Actual candidate GUI/playback/render receipts must bind the exact EXE and final manifest before task acceptance.
139 clips retain explicit unsupported controller/effect children;240 animated source assets remain catalog-only. Complete source coverage is not complete original-animation playback.
Eight short model names are duplicated; the client intentionally requires full source identity for ambiguous CLI names and shows the source path on hover in the GUI.
Static alpha/visibility source tracing is not native renderer/controller scheduling parity. This reviewer did not re-prove curve mathematics or timing.
